name: aldrich
description: Aldrich is a rounded yet squarely proportioned font that is reminiscent of early 20th Century gothic styles. With a solid stance and confident mono-weight strokes, Aldrich is a hardworking family with roots in Midwestern ethics. Documentation can be found at www.madtype.com and to contribute to the project contact Matthew Desmond at mattdesmond@gmail.com
